licenseReview.rationale: Internal review of the OpenStreetMap Foundation Licence and Legal FAQ and Attribution Guidelines: ODbL permits commercial use with attribution; public use of a substantial derived POI database requires an ODbL data offer. The project now generates a pinned source-plus-derived-data offer archive, exposes a gated public download endpoint, and returns OSM attribution with route provenance. Scope approved: local processing, runtime search, display, attribution, and distribution of the ODbL data offer. Training and evaluation remain unapproved. This is an engineering reading of the published guidance, not legal advice; seek counsel for jurisdiction-specific questions.

attributionText: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Data available under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
refreshFrequency: Provider publishes daily extracts; check before each planned refresh.
retentionPolicy: Keep the pinned snapshot, derived POI database, and reproducible data-offer archive together. Publish the ODbL offer whenever a substantial derived database is publicly used.
